apps.name: Duotone
apps.subtitle: YouTube e Spotify numa só biblioteca
apps.localizedDescription: Everything Spotify and YouTube Premium do — in one app, without either subscription. Both catalogues in a single library: search, playlists, offline downloads and a persistent player, synced to your account across iPhone and PC.
